title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 1 Writing: Charts, percent and comparisons
subtitle: Words from Lesson 4 (Writing Task 1) + percent / percentage and comparisons

words.def: a circle divided into parts to show how a total is shared
words.sent: The ___ shows the languages people speak at home in Winchester.
words.coll: a ___ chart divided into four parts

words.def: a graphic with bars of different heights to compare amounts
words.sent: The ___ shows integration problems for three age groups.
words.coll: the tallest bar in the ___ chart

words.def: a graphic with a line that shows changes over time
words.sent: The ___ shows the number of visitors to Townsville over four years.

words.def: numbers arranged in rows and columns
words.sent: The ___ shows the number of students at Broadlands Language School.
words.coll: the rows and columns of a ___

words.vi: sơ đồ, hình vẽ minh hoạ
words.def: a simple drawing that shows how something works
words.sent: The ___ shows a machine for producing electricity from waves.

words.def: to give the main points in a short form
words.sent: ___ the information by selecting and reporting the main features.

words.def: a short description of the main idea of all the information
words.sent: The last paragraph gives a general ___ of all the information.

words.def: numbers, especially official ones
words.sent: Include ___ from the chart in your summary.

words.def: to look at how two or more things are similar or different
words.sent: You must also ___ some of the information.

words.def: problems; things that are hard to deal with
words.sent: The chart shows the ___ people have when they move to a new country.

words.def: to go and live in a different place
words.sent: Many people have problems when they ___ a new country.

words.def: to be different depending on something
words.sent: The chart shows how the problems ___ age.

words.def: the people who are between two ages, e.g. 18 to 34
words.sent: The greatest problem for the youngest ___ is making friends.

words.def: a place to live or stay
words.sent: Only 22 percent of older people have trouble finding ___.

words.vi: gây khó khăn, có vấn đề
words.def: full of problems; difficult to deal with
words.sent: The older age group find learning the local language the most ___.

words.def: used to show that something is very different from what you just said
words.sent: ___, fewer people have difficulties with education.

words.def: used when you are looking at how two things are different
words.sent: 37 percent have this problem, ___ 32 percent of the younger group.

words.def: the money a person has and how they manage it
words.sent: The second biggest problem is sorting out ___.

words.def: the service of looking after people's health
words.sent: The biggest problem for the middle age group is sorting out ___.

words.vi: ở một mức độ nào đó
words.def: partly, but not completely
words.sent: In general, all people experience problems ___.

grammar.q: A problem experienced by 46 ___ of young people.
grammar.note: percent sau một con số, không có -s

grammar.q: The ___ of older people with this problem is much lower.
grammar.note: the percentage — không đi với con số cụ thể

grammar.q: By 1995, the numbers had fallen to ___ two percent.
